title: Qualify for the audit
summary: The gate that ends the page (#qualify), approved and kept: today's three-question logic, one question per screen — the question set large (64px) as the section's dominant element — beside the mail the booking opens, shown as the mail itself (To, Subject, one line per answer) and written in as you answer.

reference.site: Approved round-8 audit-gate (P09) · kit 12.9 (.ac-form / .ac-field) · GoNimbly study (few, big labels)
reference.borrowed: One question at a time with large answer rows that act on a single tap, and a progress marker that names the step in words.
reference.kelwin: The request on the right is the mail the booking opens (To, Subject, the three answers, preferred times), set as the kit's form — label above, the answer on a 22px underlined row — filling in as you tap. No letter codes, no mono keys, no window chrome; the only red is the booking, once qualified.

motion: entrance: the ruled seam draws (kit), the label fades in, the gate rises, the mail beside it, the under-note last.

interaction: hover or focus on an answer draws a 1px --fg rule across its top, nudges it 6px and draws its arrow in. A tap advances: the next screen fades in (260ms) while the screens ease to its height (320ms), the three-tick ruler extends, the answer drops into its field on the right, focus moves to the new question and the live region announces it. Back / Change last answer / Restart step back. Browser Back and refresh keep progress (#qualify:b,a,b plus history.state). A decline closes the request (only the answers given stay; 'Closed here. Nothing was sent.') and hides the under-note. 'Book the strategic call' opens the mail app and swaps its note for the confirm line with 'Copy the address'.

mockup demo (not on the live site): with no answers in the hash the gate plays B → A → B once and rests qualified at ≈5.4s; the first click or key stops it. Review links: #qualify:a (declined), #qualify:b,c (declined, PLG), #qualify:b,a (Q03), #qualify:b,a,d (qualified, all three).
on the live site: no demo. Step fades are off under reduced motion; focus and announcements stay.
story: The page's last section and its conversion moment: three taps qualify in both directions, the request writes itself beside the questions, and the call is booked from the visitor's own mail app.
copy: [N] label (the section's h2) 'Qualify for the audit' (a plain signpost; the page's clipped pairs stay the approved h1 and FAQ statement only)
[K] Q01–Q03, every answer label and detail, both decline reasons (QualifyFlow.tsx)
[N] progress 'Question n of 3' · 'Closed at question n of 3' · 'All three answered' (key voice)
[N] Q03 column 'Where the audit looks first' (phone: a visible 'Looks first' key, aria-hidden, beside the screen-reader line); aside 'A starting point only. The audit still reads all three layers.'
[R] declined 'Not a fit yet.' · 'Saying so now costs you nothing. When it changes, the audit will be here.' · [K] 'Read the field notes meanwhile' · 'Talk to the team anyway' (.ac-go, sentence case)

[R] qualified 'Qualified. Let’s find a time.' · [N] 'The audit looks first at Narrative Systems →' (or 'The audit looks at all three layers.') · [N] 'On the call we’ll ask one more thing: who inside will own the system.'
[K] 'Book the strategic call' · [K, kept as approved] note '… We reply with times within one working day. Thirty minutes, no SDR handoff.'

[N] the request, as the mail: 'Your request' · To 'audit@kelwin.co' · Subject 'Audit qualification — booking the strategic call' · Revenue / Deals / Feels like + the answer given · Times 'You add these in your mail app.' (qualified only) · 'Nothing is sent until you press send.' (declined: 'Closed here. Nothing was sent.')

[N, production note] the mail body now carries the same short keys ('Revenue: …', 'Deals: …', 'Feels like: …', 'Times:') instead of repeating the three questions, so the page shows exactly what the mail says; the subject is unchanged
[R] quiet controls 'Back' · 'Change last answer' · 'Restart' · 'Copy the address' in the key voice (Mona 15px, sentence case)
[R] under-note 'Talk to the team' + 'No qualification needed.'

retired: the 42px h2 and its lede, A–D letter codes, the .ac-doc window, mono keys, the qualified spec list, the .ac-onward row; rev. b: the label 'Three questions, then a call', the request's .ac-field rows (each question printed a second time as a field label, four empty 64px rows before any answer), the controls' 12px tracked caps, 'That’s what it is for.', the phone's CSS-content 'Looks first'
phone: ≤1023: the gate takes the full width (question 48px); the mail shows on the qualified screen only, under the booking (before that the answers are on the screen already, so no empty form sits under them). ≤767: the question at 34px; rows tighten (the arrow always drawn); Q03's 'looks first' drops under each answer with its own 'Looks first' key; exits stack; the red booking button takes the full width; the mail follows it, keys at 80px.
notes: The one red is the booking button, only in the qualified state; the FAQ's red is more than a viewport above. The mail is a <dl> (key → value); unanswered lines carry [hidden]; before the first answer the column is visibility:hidden (it keeps its place, so nothing below moves). history.state is merged, never replaced. Coherence pass: the timed demo plays only in the standalone mockup (guarded on html.km-home), so the stitched page's settled state is the same with and without motion; the request starts blank in the markup (.is-blank), so first paint already shows the state init renders.
